task: P55-N02 sub-lattice lubrication closure for near-jamming fibrous permeability

reference.hex: Gebart (1992) near-jamming closed form k = C1 R^2 (sqrt(phi_max/phi)-1)^2.5, C1 = 16/(9 pi sqrt6), phi_max = pi/(2 sqrt3)
reference.sq: Sangani & Acrivos (1982) exact drag table, k_ref = pi R^2/(phi f) (table double-transcribed in benchmarks/verified/permeability/NOTES.md)

closure.name: sub-lattice lubrication closure (SL-closure)
closure.conductance: G(delta) = int ds/h^3 = (3 pi/8) sqrt(R) delta^-5/2 for the near-contact two-cylinder parabolic gap h = delta + s^2/R (Sangani & Acrivos 1982)
closure.rule: nu_eff = nu (delta_mask/delta_true)^3 with taper weight max(0, 1 - delta_true/(1.5 dx))
closure.no_op: nu_eff == nu exactly where delta_true >= 1.5 dx

settings.primary_channel: B = reference at the realized (voxelized) solid fraction and radius (removes the O(dx^2) mask-area bias that d ln k/d phi = 15-30 amplifies near jamming); channel A = nominal-phi convention, disclosed alongside

plateau_analysis.statement: For delta_min/dx >= 1.5 the closed-case error stops descending monotonically with refinement: it saturates in a band (hex_vf0.70: 29.57 pp, hex_vf0.75: 32.51 pp, sq_vf0.40: 1.80 pp) whose width is set by the reference-model bias (Gebart asymptote vs exact solution) plus the residual GCI, not by the grid. Below delta_min/dx ~ 1.5 the error is resolution-controlled -- see the master curve.

G1_hex070.gate: hex phi=0.70: judged levels <= 5% vs Gebart, GCI band narrowing, finest GCI <= 3%
G1_hex070.channel: B (realized geometry), channel A (nominal phi) disclosed

G2_hex075.gate: hex phi=0.75: judged levels <= 5% vs Gebart, GCI band narrowing, finest GCI <= 3%
G2_hex075.channel: B (realized geometry), channel A (nominal phi) disclosed

G3_sq040.gate: sq phi=0.40: error ladder de-monotonised (no increase beyond the GCI band), GCI band narrowing, finest GCI <= 3%
G3_sq040.channel: B (realized geometry), channel A (nominal phi) disclosed

G4_dilute_negative_control.gate: dilute negative control: closure changes K by < 1% at phi = 0.05 and 0.10

G5_diagnostics.gate: diagnostics: grid-independent delta_min plus the error-vs-delta_min/dx master curve are recorded in result.json

verdict.statement: At least one gate failed -- see gates; reported as an honest FAIL.

figures.name: fig_master_curve.png
figures.caption: Error versus the grid-independent gap ratio delta_min/dx for all cases, with (solid) and without (dashed) the sub-lattice lubrication closure. Below delta_min/dx ~ 1.5 the error is resolution-controlled; above it the closure has no effect and the residual is a plateau.

figures.name: fig_ladders.png
figures.caption: Grid ladders with (circles) and without (squares) the closure; green error bars are the Roache GCI bands of the closure-on triplets.

figures.name: fig_dilute_control.png
figures.caption: Dilute negative control: the closure must be inert (<1%) at phi = 0.05 and 0.10.
